meta.title: Tabibi — Your Medical Record in Your Pocket | Case Study
meta.description: Tabibi portfolio: a complete digital platform that helps private clinic doctors manage appointments, medical records and digital prescriptions in one place — a web platform and a mobile app with a QR medical record and AI-powered documentation.

hero.eyebrow: Case study — a digital health platform from Gaza
hero.desc1: A complete digital platform that helps private clinic doctors manage appointments, medical records and digital prescriptions in one place.
hero.desc2: Available as a web platform and a mobile app, with a record that follows the patient everywhere via a QR code, and smart documentation that turns the doctor's voice notes into a structured record.

stats.label: QR medical record and smart documentation

problem.title: A scattered medical history — decisions made without context
problem.story: Mohammed, a heart patient, visited a private clinic doctor without owning a unified medical record. The doctor had no background on his chronic conditions, allergies or medications — putting his life at risk and forcing him to repeat tests that could have been avoided.

cards.title: No unified record
cards.text: Patients move between doctors and specialties without a single medical record that follows them.

cards.title: Unsafe decisions
cards.text: Missing medical history, allergies and medications can expose the patient to an unsafe medical decision.

cards.title: Costly repeat tests
cards.text: Without a record, patients are forced to repeat tests and prescriptions that could have been avoided.

cards.title: Medical record via QR
cards.text: A private barcode that follows the patient everywhere. The doctor scans it and instantly reaches the medical history, medications and allergies, then adds the new visit to the record.

cards.title: Smart documentation with the AI Agent
cards.text: The doctor dictates notes in their own voice, and the AI automatically turns them into structured symptoms, diagnosis, prescription and instructions.

cards.title: Connected to the ecosystem
cards.text: An open platform linking the health record with clinics, laboratories, pharmacies and hospitals.

solution.bandTitle: From scan to record in a single visit
solution.bandText: A barcode travels with the patient, a voice documents the visit, AI structures the fields, and the doctor reviews and approves before anything is saved.

timeline.title: Five steps from scanning the QR to saving the visit
timeline.desc: The exact workflow the mobile app runs between patient and doctor.

steps.title: Patient shows the code
steps.text: The patient shows their QR code from the mobile app — it can even be placed on the back of the phone.

steps.title: Doctor scans it
steps.text: The medical record and medical history open for them immediately.

steps.title: Voice note
steps.text: The doctor records a voice note: symptoms, diagnosis, clinical observations and the prescription.

steps.title: AI analysis
steps.text: The AI Agent analyzes the speech and distributes it into the right fields: symptoms, diagnosis, notes, prescription.

steps.title: Review and save
steps.text: The doctor reviews and approves the fields, then the visit is saved and the medical record and history update automatically.

ai.sttNote: We are currently selecting an accurate speech-to-text engine that supports multiple languages.
ai.securityDesc: Privacy is not an extra feature — it is a requirement in every step.
security: QR scanning rights are limited to doctors registered and approved on the platform, not any doctor outside it.
Permissions are separated: the secretary cannot reach the medical record or conversations unless the doctor decides so.
We strip patient identity: name, ID number and phone are removed before any text is sent to the AI.
Nothing is saved to the record before the doctor reviews and approves it.
Voice recordings are not kept after transcription.
An audit log for every access to a patient's record.

tech.title: A simplified architecture diagram
tech.desc: Web and mobile talk to a single API, a single central record, and an AI layer behind authentication.

arch.apiSub: ASP.NET Core 10 · SignalR · JWT + Google OAuth

decisions.title: Three decisions that shaped the build

cards.title: Flexible secretary permissions
cards.text: One interface for doctor and secretary, with page-by-page permission control: what is granted to the secretary, and what stays with the doctor only.

cards.title: QR as a secure entry to the record
cards.text: We made the QR code the entry point to the medical record, surrounded by protection layers: approved doctors, doctor review before saving, and an audit log for every access.

cards.title: Performance through chunking
cards.text: We split the Vite build into independent chunks (react-core, icons, animation, i18n) so they are not all loaded at once.
